description: CPIC pharmacogenetics guidelines (api.cpicpgx.org) for a gene symbol: guideline name, genes covered, guideline version, and ClinPGx link. Lists guidelines only; recommendation text is not included. Up to 20 guidelines per call. Related tools on this server, for a different need: health_clinical_evidence_cochrane when you need Cochrane systematic reviews of health interventions, found; health_clinical_trials_gov when you need ClinicalTrials.gov study search: NCT ID, title, status. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

gene.description: Gene symbol, letters, digits and hyphens, 2 to 20 characters
